cp11:1.1: Yadā ahosiṃ pavane kuñjaro mātuposako na tadā atthi mahiyā guṇena mama sādiso. || ||
cp11:2.1: Pavane disvā vanacaro rañño maṃ paṭivedayi: tavānucchavo mahārāja gajo vasati kānane. || ||
cp11:3.1: Na tassa parikhāy' attho na pi āḷakakāsuyā samāgahite soṇḍāya sayam-eva idh' ehiti. || ||
cp11:4.1: Tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā rājā pi tuṭṭhamānaso pesesi hatthidamakaṃ chekācariyaṃ susikkhitaṃ. || ||
cp11:5.1: Gantvā so hatthidamako addasa padumassare bhisamuḷālaṃ uddharantaṃ yāpanatthāya mātuyā. || ||
cp11:6.1: Viññāya me sīlaguṇaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ upadhārayi, ehi puttā 'ti vatvāna mama soṇḍāya aggahi. || ||
cp11:7.1: Yaṃ me tadā pākatikaṃ sarīrānugataṃ balaṃ ajja nāgasahassānaṃ balena samasādisaṃ. || ||
cp11:8.1: Yadi' haṃ tesaṃ pakuppeyyaṃ upetaṃ gahaṇāya maṃ paṭibalo bhave tesaṃ yāva rajjam-pi mānusaṃ. || ||
cp11:9.1: Api cāhaṃ sīlarakkhāya sīlapāramipūriyā na karomi citte aññathattaṃ pakkhipante mam-āḷake. || ||
cp11:10.1: Yadi te maṃ tattha koṭṭeyyuṃ pharasūhi tomarehi ca n' eva tesaṃ pakuppeyyaṃ sīlakhaṇḍabhayā mamā 'ti. || ||
